title: Pack One Flexible Layer
description: Bring a light jacket or overshirt that works for chilly buses, breezy beaches, and early trail starts.

title: Plan Around One Main Stop
description: Choose one destination as the anchor for the day, then add nearby food, photos, or walks if there is time.

title: Save Offline Details
description: Before leaving, save the address, bus route, meeting spot, and return plan in case service gets weak.

title: Use Golden Hour
description: Early morning and late afternoon light can make even simple places feel more memorable in photos.

title: Keep a Small Budget Buffer
description: Set aside a little extra for snacks, transit changes, parking, or a place you discover along the way.

title: Leave Time to Wander
description: The best part of a student trip is often the unplanned cafe, quiet overlook, or photo you almost missed.
